dailyTopNewsBrief.headline: Panthers (5-5) Week 12 Briefing: Injury Updates Ahead of Buccaneers
bullets: Injury & Practice Status: Entering Week 12 preparation, head coach Dave Canales and the medical staff evaluate WR Jalen Coker (concussion), LB Bobby Okereke (foot), WR Tetairoa McMillan (foot), and CB Mike Jackson (groin) ahead of Wednesday's initial participation report [Joe Person](https://www.espn.com/nfl/player/_/id/4685472/tetairoa-mcmillan#:~:text=McMillan%20wasn't%20spotted%20at%20Wednesday's%20unofficial%20practice). G Brady Christensen (hamstring) and LB Thomas Incoom (calf) continue ramping inside active 21-day Injured Reserve practice windows toward potential 53-man roster activation [Mike Kaye](https://www.espn.com/nfl/player/_/id/4678008/jonathon-brooks#:~:text=Head%20coach%20Dave%20Canales%20suggested%20Wednesday%20that).

Week 12 Buccaneers Outlook: Dave Canales and DC Todd Wash open installation for the Tampa Bay Buccaneers (3-7, TB -3, HC/DC Todd Bowles & OC Zac Robinson (Road Test))—a unit ranked #1 in Rushing Yards / Game (159.5 yds) as Carolina prepares for a pivotal NFC matchup [panthers.com Official](https://www.panthers.com/news/know-your-foe-week-12-tampa-bay-buccaneers) [ESPN](https://www.espn.com/nfl/preview?gameId=401873094).

NFC Playoff Trajectory: Entering Week 12 at 5-5 (1st in NFC South • #4 Seed in NFC), Carolina carries a 52.2% postseason projection, 51.9% NFC South division title mark, and 0% #1 Seed Bye equity into the conference stretch [Walker Clement](https://www.catscratchreader.com/carolina-panthers-discussion/62568/thanksgiving-day-football-open-thread).

Around the Beat: Per NFL Network’s Cameron Wolfe, the Panthers and QB Bryce Young have not had contract talks in-season, but the two sides are on the same page regarding a new deal in the offseason [NFL Trade Rumors](https://nfltraderumors.co/bryce-young-panthers-on-same-page-regarding-offseason-contract-extension/).
